purpose: Controlled multi-column board for reordering cards within and across workflow columns with keyboard, pointer, and live-region feedback.
useWhen: Presenting a workflow board where users move cards between ordered columns.
Cards need a title over one quiet row (an assignee, a priority badge), or consumers own card rendering.

avoidWhen.reason: Showing a single ordered list — use sortable-list instead.
Sorting by computed fields rather than direct manual placement.
